blocks.text: Memo: case-pick pallet when the order is 8 cases or more

This is the working cut for PCF-MEM-2024-128 on November 7, 2024. Marcus Hale asked for a written bound after the current path (Pickers carton-each because UPH loves cartons) stopped being honest. I am Jeilen Jones, Order Picker, writing for Marcus Hale, Tasha Quinn, and Ben Crowe. Primary host wms.pinecrest.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on carton-each to keep UPH pretty, then open questions. If you are on the floor next shift, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the steps.

At 8 cases, switch to pallet case-pick. WMS flag. Do not carton-each a pallet order to protect UPH. I am not restating a hallway yes. carton-each to keep UPH pretty is out because UPH counts cartons. It does not count a wrecked dock. October 18 12-case order took 41 minutes carton-each. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: cases=8, minutes=41, order=12, weeks=2, uph=310, dock=1, flag=1, back=1. Sibling tickets PCF-2340 and PCF-TDD-2024-024. I will not reopen carton-each to keep UPH pretty in a side thread because someone asked for a rate waiver. Tasha Quinn is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.
